Dans un milieu favorable, elle reste très difficile à trouver.

Pour en tirer ses propriétés, elle s’emploie par application directe.

This stem is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in freshwater banks and shores, and is best known in south-eastern Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

To obtain its properties, it is used by direct application.

A fresh stalk, crushed into a poultice and placed on a properly set fracture, doubles the natural rate of knitting. It loses its potency within a few hours.
